note: Frozen canonical account encoding (logos-contract §2a quote · §9 ClauseId). For each clause, `id` = lowercase-hex SHA-256(CLAUSE_PREFIX ‖ ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term))), where CLAUSE_PREFIX = 'logos/account/clause/v1\n' (hex below), clause-as-term = Tuple[head, Tuple[body...]], and head/body goals read as Tuple[Atom(pred), args...]. A POSITIVE body literal reads byte-identically to the bare goal; a NEGATED body literal `\+ p(t...)` (ADR 0007) reads as Tuple[Atom(NEG_TAG=0x00), goal-as-term], authored as {neg: <goal>}. SYNTACTIC: variable names are part of the encoding (no alpha-normalization), so p(X):-q(X) and p(Y):-q(Y) differ. Any {rs,ts,go} binding's ClauseId::canonical MUST reproduce `id`. Term notation as in check.json: term = {atom:<hex>}|{atom_str:<utf8>}|{tuple:[...]}|{var:<id>}; goal = {pred:<utf8>, args:[term...]}; negated body literal = {neg: <goal>}.
